description: This PHP source file defines the EmploymentStatusController class within the OrangeHRM Admin module. The class extends an abstract Vue controller and is responsible for setting up a Vue component named 'employment-status-list' during the pre-rendering phase.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing employment status related views in the admin section, extending the AbstractVueController to leverage Vue.js integration for frontend rendering.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes a Vue component named 'employment-status-list' prior to rendering the view. It creates a new Component instance and sets it for the controller.
